Chapter 545 - 545 Ask And Answer

Chapter 545 - 545 Ask And Answer

545 Ask And Answer

Man in the Wind: [On the first day of school, when I walked past the basketball court on the field, I saw a guy pick up a black wallet. After secretly stuffing it into his pocket, he hurriedly left. He wasn’t wearing glasses and was wearing a gray T-shirt. He’s about 180 meters tall. If someone dropped their wallet, get it back from this person. Back.jpg]

After Tang Yuan sent the message to his friends, he sent the same message to the class group, the grade group, and the school group, which caused a lot of discussion.

Second Brother Song: [Picking up a wallet and stuffing it into your pocket? There’s actually such a person in this world?]

Chaos: [Man in the Wind seems to be the head of the student council, Tang Yuan. His words must be true. I’ll keep an eye out for the guy.]

King: [I’ll keep an eye out too.]

Poor Man: [So, it’s Tang Yuan. Then his words are definitely true. He’s the leader of our student union.]

Bear: [As expected of Tang Yuan. He’s brave and full of a sense of justice. He exposes injustice directly when he sees it. Awesome!]

One, Two, Three, Wooden Figure: [This guy is really embarrassing Jiangbei University!]

Xue: [Embarrassing? This isn’t just embarrassing! It’s already a crime. If there was more than 2,000 yuan in the wallet, he could even be sentenced to theft! Tang Yuan, I suggest you call the police now and have them arrest him!]

As more and more people joined the discussion, Tang Yuan looked at everyone’s insults toward Lin Fan and their flattery toward him. He felt like he was on cloud nine.

He liked this feeling very much.

Tang Yuan sneered in his heart, ‘Kid, you didn’t want to let me cut queue, huh? Let’s see how doomed you’ll be this time.’

At the same time, Tang Yuan’s mind began to work.

Many internet celebrities suddenly became popular because of a certain matter.

If this worked, could he also become an internet celebrity?

In that case, he would not have to worry about food and clothing in the future.

Thinking of this, Tang Yuan’s heart began to beat faster.

He opened Weibo and posted the same message online.

Then, he went to place an order and hired a group of internet trolls to repost and comment on it.

As one of the 10 ten universities in the country, Jiangbei University had a certain level of popularity.

After Lin Fan joined Jiangbei University, he solved many math problems and won the Fields Medal. He also invented many high-tech products such as super batteries, the earthquake prediction device, carbon-based chips, and so on. After winning four Nobel Prizes, Jiangbei University became even more famous.

The place really attracted the attention and discussion of many people.

Later on, under the push of some people, the number of comments on Tang Yuan’s Weibo post went from a few hundred to a few thousand. It later reached tens of thousands!

Finally, a headline appeared on Weibo: [The thief from Jiangbei University!]

This headline even climbed to the top of the trending searches.

Some people berated Lin Fan, some suggested calling the police, and some even came to Jiangbei University to find the man in the gray T-shirt!

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this at all.

At this moment, he had already arrived at the office.

Most students would not be in the mood to study or read on the first and last day of school.

However, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others had already buried their heads in learning.

“Meow!”

Lil White, who was on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder, was the first to notice Lin Fan and let out a loud cry.

“Master, you’re finally here!

“Master, I missed you so much!

“Master, can you give me something delicious?

Lil White meowed as it came to Lin Fan’s feet. It kept rubbing against him.

To be honest, Lin Fan missed not petting the cat for two months.

He bent down and rubbed it from its head to toe a few times.

Then, he picked up a bag of premium beef cat food and placed it on the ground.

Lil White stuffed its entire head into the cat food and began to eat.

It was super delicious!

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu felt his cat, Lil White, jump off his shoulder. He looked up and saw Lin Fan. He shouted excitedly, “Professor Lin!”

Then, everyone raised their heads.

“Professor Lin!”

They had not seen each other for two months. At this moment, everyone was very excited.

Firstly, it was because they missed Lin Fan.

Secondly, they were grateful to Lin Fan!

Gratitude?

That was right!

That was because before the summer break, all of the theses they wrote had successfully been published in top journals after Lin Fan’s revision.

In other words…

Each of them was a top-tier author!

One had to know…

Many university professors did not even have their works published in a single top-tier publication!

This was definitely an incredible matter.

They understood that it was all Lin Fan’s credit.

…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue took out two bottles of energy drink and handed them to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan nodded his head at them. Then, he took the energy drinks and drank a mouthful of each. “Did you encounter any problems in the past two months?”

In fact, he was just asking casually.

Usually, summer vacation was a good time for students to rest.

However…

Lin Fan’s students were obviously not ordinary.

“Professor Lin, I’ve done some research on the nervous system, but there are still many things that I don’t quite understand…” Hao Zhiwu was the first to speak.

As he spoke, he took out a stack of draft paper.

Every page of draft paper was filled with densely packed figures and characters, and there were also marks of different colors.

If it were an ordinary teacher, they would probably have a headache seeing so many draft papers.

However, Lin Fan did not care at all. He just looked at Hao Zhiwu with a slightly different expression.

Then, he picked up the papers and quickly flipped through the stack.

In about two minutes, Lin Fan had read through all the content and understood everything that was involved.

“You need to strengthen your neural connections and neurons. Also, there’s a problem with your reaction here…”

“I see. Thank you, Professor!” Hao Zhiwu said.

At the same time, his admiration for Lin Fan grew.

He had only flipped through it a few times and already knew the problem. As expected of a professor!

Then, Jiang Chaoqun walked over with a stack of draft paper and asked questions.

Then, it was Liu Qianqian and Nie Zhenjiang…

Lin Fan spent about ten minutes answering their questions.

Then, his gaze fell on Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

“Have you encountered any questions that you can’t answer?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s pretty faces instantly blushed. They nodded lightly and said, “Yes!”

After saying that, they took out a stack of draft paper.

Some people said that geniuses were a result of 99% sweat and 1% inspiration.

This sentence… Perhaps it was an exaggeration.

However, one thing was right.

Geniuses often worked harder than ordinary people.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others were the best proof.

They came to the office early every day. Even though it was a leisurely summer vacation, they did not relax.
